testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel from the left-docked ribbon context menu: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:72:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel from the left-docked ribbon context menu ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left ✔ And the Modify group is visible ✔ When the user opens the ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels ✔ Then Modify is checked ✔ When the user selects Modify in Show Panels ✔ Then the Modify group disappears from the side-docked ribbon ✔ And the remaining ribbon groups reflow vertically ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels from the ribbon context menu ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify in Show Panels ✔ Then the Modify group returns to the side-docked ribbon ✔ And Modify is checked ✔ And the remaining ribbon groups return to their earlier positions ✔ And the part remains active
